tagline: The weight carried low in the hull, so rough water cannot turn the vessel over — measured in money. Ninety days projected forward, and one honest number for today.
launchSub: Local-first · no server · runs entirely in your browser

cards.html: Vanilla JS, no backend, no account, no server to trust with the numbers. Everything is entered and stored locally, in the browser that's running it.

features.d: current balance, monthly bills, monthly net income, and monthly surplus at a glance.
every bill and income event plotted forward, with the lowest projected balance flagged before it happens.
recurring obligations tracked against their real due dates, not just a monthly total.
what's actually safe to spend today without breaking the projection.

lede: A bank balance tells you what's there right now. It doesn't tell you what's already spoken for — the rent that clears Friday, the card payment due next week, the subscription that renews before the next paycheck lands. Ballast puts every recurring bill on a real calendar and projects the balance forward, so "can I afford this today" has an actual answer instead of a guess.
scope: This is a personal budgeting tool, not a bank integration or a financial advisor. Balances and projections are only as accurate as what's entered — it doesn't see your actual accounts, and it won't warn you about anything it wasn't told about.
closing: Ballast keeps the ship upright. Not the cargo — just the weight.
